components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action, with a theme-specific blue or mint gradient and clear touch sizing.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-accent), var(--color-accent-strong)); color: var(--color-on-accent); font: 800 1rem/1.15 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action with a quiet ink wash, border, and high-contrast label.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; min-width: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--color-ink-soft); color: var(--color-ink); font: 800 1rem/1.15 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--color-toggle-hover); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A touch-sized field with a soft fill and tonal outline.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 700 0.875rem/1.3 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-control-bg); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1rem/1.4 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent-strong); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Compact uppercase status or selection label with a full pill silhouette.
components.css: .ds-state-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-pill-bg); color: var(--color-ink); font: 800 0.75rem/1.2 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-state-chip--selected { border-color: var(--color-accent-strong-soft); background: var(--color-accent-soft); color: var(--color-accent-strong); }

narrative.overview:
BenchMaster’s visual language pairs the clarity of a coach’s working board with a subtle basketball-court setting. A restrained court-line and wood-grain backdrop gives the app its sport context; foreground surfaces remain calm and high contrast so a coach can read a clock, find a player, and act quickly during a game. The interface favors practical grouping, explicit status, and direct touch controls over decorative display. Controls feel tactile and fast, with clear feedback and direct labels.

The system supports a cool court-side palette: a cool blue light theme and a deep green-blue dark theme. Court-orange accents mark basketball-specific context and starter/bench distinctions; the primary action color changes to mint in dark mode. Use the supplied BenchMaster logo as the brand mark and preserve French and English interface support.
keyCharacteristics: A quiet court-side atmosphere behind operational surfaces.
Large, direct controls suited to one-handed touch use.
Player identity, live status, and game data are grouped into compact cards.
Light and dark themes each use their own semantic accent palette.

rules.name: The Theme-Paired Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the blue action palette in light mode and the mint action palette in dark mode; keep court amber reserved for basketball context and game data.

rules.name: The Scan-First Type Rule
rules.body: Reserve uppercase, tracked type for short labels and statuses; keep instructions and longer copy in sentence case with comfortable line height.

dos: Do preserve both the light blue and dark mint theme palettes.
Do reserve warm court colors for basketball context, starter/bench data, and related highlights.
Do keep touch controls at least 44px tall and primary calls to action 48px tall.
Do use the provided logo asset and keep the French and English interface supported.
Do retain the low-contrast court setting behind high-contrast operational surfaces.
Do allow player names, labels, and action text to wrap on small screens.
donts: Don’t use the court texture or grain as a high-contrast foreground pattern.
Don’t mix the light-theme blue action color into dark-theme primary controls; use the dark-theme mint tokens.
Don’t use court amber as the default action color.
Don’t shrink live-game or player controls below their established touch-target sizing.
Don’t make live status, errors, selection, or disabled states depend on color alone; pair color with labels, borders, or shape.
